title: narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. pallidiflorus
intro: Narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. pallidiflorus, commonly known as the pale daffodil, is a subspecies of flowering plant belonging to the Narcissus genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. pallidiflorus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, that may exert anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
